facts.business: GRE Renew Enertech Limited is a renewable energy company specializing in solar EPC solutions and energy-efficient LED lighting, delivering turnkey rooftop and ground-mounted solar power solutions for industrial, commercial, and government customers across India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on renewable energy assets and project infrastructure
7.20 MW (AC) / 9.99 MW (DC) Ground Mounted Solar Power Plant in Gujarat

auditor.name: M/s. Vivek J. Vakharia & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Audit Report does not contain any qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer.

key_risks: Concentration Risk: Significant portion of operations and revenues concentrated in Solar EPC business and historically in Gujarat; slowdown in project awards, regional policy changes, competitive pressures or market disruptions may adversely affect business performance.
Project Execution Risk: Delays in project execution due to regulatory approvals, land acquisition, supply chain disruptions, or force majeure events.
Regulatory and Policy Risk: Changes in government policies, tariffs, renewable purchase obligations, or incentive schemes impacting project viability.
Working Capital and Liquidity Risk: High working capital requirements due to project cycles, receivables, and inventory; dependence on timely payments from customers.
Interest Rate and Financing Risk: Exposure to interest rate fluctuations and availability of cost-effective financing for projects.
Technology and Market Risk: Rapid technological changes, evolving customer preferences, and increasing competition in solar EPC and RESCO segments.
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions entered into during the Financial Year were in compliance with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. All transactions were reviewed and approved by the Audit Committee and, wherever required, by the Board of Directors and Members of the Company and were undertaken in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. No materially significant Related Party Transactions which had a potential conflict with the interests of the Company were reported. The Board approved a Supplementary Deed to the Inter-Corporate Loan Agreement with GRE Green Energy Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary, revising the purpose of the loan to general corporate purposes and permitting disbursement up to an aggregate amount.
